options.name: admins
options.description: The list of administrator certificates for this organization. Administrator certificates must be supplied as base64 encoded PEM files.

options.name: api_authtype
options.description: C(basic) - Authenticate to the Fabric operations console using basic authentication. You must provide both a valid API key using I(api_key) and API secret using I(api_secret).

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The URL for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_key
options.description: The API key for the Fabric operations console.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: The API secret for the Fabric operations console. Only required when I(api_authtype) is C(basic).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: The timeout, in seconds, to use when interacting with the Fabric operations console.

options.name: certificate_authority
options.description: The certificate authority to use to build this organization. You can pass a string, which is the display name of a certificate authority registered with the Fabric operations console. You can also pass a dictionary, which must match the result format of one of the M(certificate_authority_info) or M(certificate_authority) modules.

options.name: fabric_node_ous
options.description: Configuration specific to the identity classification.

options.name: hsm
options.description: The PKCS #11 compliant HSM configuration to use for digital signatures. Only required if the identity specified in I(registrar) was enrolled using an HSM.

options.name: intermediate_certs
options.description: The list of intermediate certificates for this organization. Intermediate certificates must be supplied as base64 encoded PEM files.

options.name: msp_id
options.description: The MSP ID for the organization. Only required when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: organizational_unit_identifiers
options.description: The list of organizational unit identifiers for this organization.

options.name: registrar
options.description: The identity to use when interacting with the certificate authority. If you want a CRL (Certificate Revocation List) generated from the certificate authority, you must supply an identity to use as the registrar. You can pass a string, which is the path to the JSON file where the enrolled identity is stored. You can also pass a dict, which must match the result format of one of the M(enrolled_identity_info) or M(enrolled_identity) modules.

options.name: revocation_list
options.description: The list of revoked certificates for this organization. Revoked certificates must be supplied as base64 encoded PEM files.

options.name: root_certs
options.description: The list of root certificates for this organization. Root certificates must be supplied as base64 encoded PEM files.

options.name: state
options.description: C(absent) - An organization matching the specified name will be stopped and removed. C(present) - Asserts that an organization matching the specified name and configuration exists. If no organization matches the specified name, an organization will be created. If an organization matches the specified name but the configuration does not match, then the organization will be updated, if it can be. If it cannot be updated, it will be removed and re-created with the specified configuration.

options.name: tls_intermediate_certs
options.description: The list of TLS root certificates for this organization. TLS intermediate certificates must be supplied as base64 encoded PEM files.

options.name: tls_root_certs
options.description: The list of TLS root certificates for this organization. TLS root certificates must be supplied as base64 encoded PEM files.
